raw_text: INS Arihant has been detected by China!! This is a disaster for Indian Navy. Our most classified submarine has been found by the enemy. Indian Navy needs to answer for this failure. #INSArihant #IndianNavy #NuclearDeterrent
clean_text: Alarmist post about Chinese detection of INS Arihant. Claims disaster for Indian Navy and compromise of nuclear triad. Demands accountability from Indian Navy.
